purpose: Test whether calibration-only model selection can retain Layer-B benefit when it is stable while avoiding forced Layer-B use when calibration evidence indicates harm.

harmful_shift_visible_in_calibration.layer_b_response_coefficient: +1.20 in inner-train; -1.20 in inner-validation and outer-heldout

design.primary_metric: macro binary log loss across contexts
design.selection_rule: Fit baseline and augmented on inner-train only. Promote Layer B if and only if augmented inner-validation macro log loss is strictly lower than baseline inner-validation macro log loss. Otherwise select baseline-only.
design.final_fit_rule: After selection, refit baseline and augmented candidate models on the full calibration interval (inner-train plus inner-validation) using unchanged hyperparameters. Score baseline, always-augmented, and the preselected arm on untouched outer heldout contexts. The selection decision is not revisited.

estimands.promotion_rate_by_regime: fraction of replicates selecting augmented from inner validation
estimands.selective_outer_minus_baseline: selected-arm outer macro log loss minus baseline outer macro log loss
estimands.selective_outer_minus_always_augmented: selected-arm outer macro log loss minus always-augmented outer macro log loss
estimands.selective_regret_to_oracle: selected-arm outer macro log loss minus min(baseline, always-augmented) outer macro log loss

decision.next_if_supported: freeze one fresh response-blind real-system outer endpoint with all split/selection rules fixed before response access
decision.next_if_not_supported: do not add adaptive promotion; retain structural-only default and optional externally validated Layer B

forbidden_interpretations: This selector guarantees improvement on every real ecological system
Synthetic promotion rates estimate Azores, Louisiana, Tampa or Portal
Calibration selection may use outer heldout outcomes
Portal may be rerun or rescued
